Create an open science-fiction power installation scene under cool daylight, with weathered metallic ground and restrained glowing accents. A tall central tower stands in front of two smaller towers. Low mounds line the rear and sides, leaving the front open. Keep a broad approach from the front to the central tower. Group generators to its right, with curved pipes running to its base and extra pipes beside the generators. Put power-line units behind the generators and cords near their bases. Place a metal statue to the left of the approach, apart from the machinery.
